items.title: Classify the only mechanically safe non-code-phase automatic idle handoff
items.context: Distinguish lease state as absent, valid, or malformed. Auto-eligibility is restricted to ownershipClass=storyScopedMutating and phase PLAN, REVIEW, or TEST, plus stale heartbeat, canonical same-worktree realpath, same hostname, stable supported owner/contender session identities, and authoritative ESRCH for the last mutating lattice CLI PID. DEV, dangerousMutating, agent_prompt direct acquisition, EPERM, live/reused PID, derived identity, remote host, malformed lease, and unknown liveness are never auto-eligible.
items.userSees: In PLAN, REVIEW, or TEST a stale same-worktree storyScopedMutating command reports automatic idle handoff only when no owner Lattice command is in flight; DEV and dangerous commands still require explicit takeover.
excludes: Automatic handoff in DEV or terminal phases
Automatic handoff for dangerousMutating or agent_prompt
Remote, malformed, derived-identity, PID-live, EPERM, or unknown states

items.title: Make every owner-lease mutation a recoverable atomic single-winner transaction
items.context: Put acquire, refresh, release, explicit takeover, and automatic handoff behind one per-story mkdir transaction lock. Re-read and classify under the lock; publish with unique same-directory temp plus atomic rename. Every transfer has a unique transferId and the lease remains pending until idempotent takeover-counter reconciliation succeeds. acquire/refresh/release reconcile pending state or fail closed. The unified gate may auto-handoff only its narrow eligible branch; story-aware agent_prompt uses the transactional acquire/refresh API but remains manual-only and never invokes auto eligibility.
items.userSees: A real two-session race produces exactly one owner; no command proceeds with a pending counter, and agent_prompt never silently transfers a foreign lease.
excludes: Changing agent_prompt role or envelope semantics

items.title: Persist handoff authorization before transfer and keep one convergence counter
items.context: Before lease publication, the unified gate appends a required Story process-event with unique transferId, automatic-stale-same-worktree-idle reason, phase, command class, former owner, and new owner. If persistence fails, no transfer occurs. The existing convergence-breaker takeover-count.json is the sole operational counter, upgraded to atomic idempotent transfer-id accounting; the pending lease marker makes crash recovery mechanical. Durable process-events survive lease release and terminal archival; activity-log output is a secondary mirror. session_brief and docs explain the bounded auto case and manual fallbacks.
items.userSees: session_brief names the automatic-stale-same-worktree-idle transfer and count, or explains DEV, dangerousMutating, active, malformed, or identity uncertainty as an explicit-takeover requirement.
excludes: Treating best-effort activity logging as gate evidence
Claiming the former host session is dead

items.title: Prove bounded auto handoff, crash reconciliation, and fail-closed refusal with real processes
items.context: Use real child processes to prove TEST storyScopedMutating stale idle success, DEV refusal, dangerousMutating refusal, live long-running owner-command refusal, old session blocked after transfer, two simultaneous auto-takers exactly one winner, malformed/invalid lease refusal, remote/different-worktree/derived identity refusal, explicit takeover regression, process-event persistence failure before transfer, crash after lease publish with pending counter then idempotent recovery, and agent_prompt manual-only behavior. Mutation controls must show the tests fail if phase/class fences, transaction lock, durable authorization, or pending reconciliation are removed.
items.userSees: The focused smoke prints PASS only when TEST auto-handoff is single-winner and crash-recoverable while DEV, dangerous, malformed, active, ambiguous, and agent_prompt paths remain protected.
